title: Autoridadar jisktʼasir wali valorani alma
intro: Quran anales ukanx mä jaqiw jakasïna, jupax qamirïtapa ukat yatiñanakapax leyenda ukar tukuwayi. Uka almax aka oraqet mistunïnwa k’achacht’äwinakampi ukat qamir yänakampi, ukax uñch’ukirinakarux ch’amakt’ayäna, ukampis chuymapax jach’a jach’a tukuñampiw jilxattawayi. Jiwasamp chikt’asipxam, Quran ukan mä juk’a amuyt’ayir cuento ukan misterio ukar uñt’ayañasataki, kawkhantix material grandeza ukax mä humilde tukuyampiw jikisi, uka uraqi manqhanx kunatix jupanakan fortunap yuriwayi.
clues: Uraqitjja, adornonakampi kʼachachtʼataw mistuyäta, uka kʼachachtʼäwinakaw taqenis uñchʼukïna.
Jachʼa qamirïta ukat wali yatiñaniraktwa, ukanakaw mayninakat sipansa mayjäyäta.
Kunawsatix mä yatiyirix jaqinakar Allah ukar jawsayas jutäna ukhax nayax jach’a jach’a tukusaw jupanakan autoridadapat jiskt’asiyäta.
Jak’a jak’ankirinakax Allahan khuyapayasiñapax janiw qamirïñax utjkiti sasaw jisk’at sapxirïtu.
Markajajj jachʼa kankañajat wal muspharapjjäna, nayar uñtasit mä destino utjañapwa munapjjäna.
Nayan jachʼa luratanakajajj Diosan castigoparjamaw oraqer taqpach manqʼantatäjjäna.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
